key_insight: A hybrid Transformer + Artificial Bee Colony search strategy can generate compact neural architectures on consumer hardware while balancing global exploration and local refinement.
engineering_relevance: The method makes NAS more practical for resource-constrained teams by reducing search cost, controlling model size, and targeting deployment-friendly networks.
method: Transformer controller proposes architectures via reinforcement learning.
Dynamic entropy increases exploration when search stalls.
ABC algorithm refines candidate architectures locally to improve performance.
evidence_signal: On an NVIDIA RTX 3060, the approach found a CIFAR-10 model with 84.85% accuracy in about 3 hours using ~174k parameters, and a fraud-detection model with F1 = 0.71 using ~4.6k parameters.
watch_item: Results are promising but may depend on careful tuning of RL, entropy triggers, and ABC settings to avoid unstable search behavior or overfitting to a specific task.
paper_title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
